messages:
Priya: Heads up — customer reported rerank accuracy drop after we changed embed dim from 1536->1024 in the PRD variant. Need decision on launch gates and acceptance criteria. They flagged MRR down ~6% on one query set. /cc @Marco
Marco: Can you drop the failing eval set and perf numbers? Also is the dim change necessary vs quant/normalize?
Priya: Quick numbers: baseline MRR 0.42 -> new 0.395 on customer set (n=1k). Cosine avg similarity down 0.04. Latency + cost improve ~18%.
Jules: Tradeoff makes sense but need backwards compatibility story. Options: versioned embeddings, server-side up/projection, or require reindex.
Alex: For product, we need launch gates: (1) <1.5% MRR regression on global benchmark (2) no >5% regressions on any named customer set (3) migration plan for existing indexes (4) API contract for dimension mismatch.
Priya: Proposed migration: auto-projection on ingest using learned linear map, opt-in reindex job, and a deprecation notice for old dims. Can we measure projection fidelity?
Marco: Projection QC: holdout validation, measure cosine recovery and rerank delta. If projection MRR drop <1% vs native new-dim, ok.
Jules: Edge case: normalized vs unnormalized embeddings. Need to lock normalization policy — server always normalizes L2 on store and query to avoid shifts.
Alex: Also batch semantics: ensure incremental reindex maintains stable shard-level normalization; add DCAP safety guard for partial batches.
Priya: Action items: Marco run projection sim by EOD Wed, include per-customer worst-case; Jules draft API addition for dimension mismatch and deprecation timeline; Alex write launch-gate checklist.
ops-bot: Deploy job scheduled: embedding-projection-sim-2026-04-14 03:00 UTC
Marco: Will share results in #eng-ml thread. If projection fails, fallback is dedicated migration window and customer opt-in.
Priya: Thanks. If anyone objects to the launch gates above speak now, otherwise I'll put on PRD.
